decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the end of three years from the date of this permission.

Reason: In order to comply with the provisions of Section 91 of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be carried out in accordance with the following approved plans:

Heritage Statement dated 17th August 2026 prepared by Squire Heritage Consulting; 83HWH-(PL)100P-Rev.P01; (PL)099 Rev.P01; 83HWH-(EX)001-Rev.P01; 83HWH-(EX)010-Rev.P01; Sustainable Design and Construction Statement Rev.P1 dated 8th September 2026 prepared by CJOK Architects; Environmental Noise Assessment ref. 104920.ad.Issue2 dated 10/09/2026 prepared by Acoustics Plus; (PL)103 Rev.P03; (PL)100 Rev.P02; 83HWH-(PL)010-Rev.P02; Tree condition statement prepared by Graftin Gardeners; Design & Access Statement dated 30 September 2026 prepared by CJOK Architects; (PL)301 Rev.P02; Tree Protection Plan ref. 24-25890-TPP-001 dated 01 October 2026 prepared by Graftin Gardeners; Document titled "Regularisation document identifying the approved, existing and proposed" dated 05 October 2026 prepared by CJOK Architects; 83HWH-(PL)202-Rev.P01; Document titled "Second Floor Proposed Stair" dated 27 October 2026 prepared by CJOK Architects; (PL)102 Rev.P03; (21)301 Rev.P01; (21)300 Rev.P01; (PL)302 Rev.P03; (PL)300 Rev.P03; Document titled "Air Vent" dated 23 November 2026 prepared by CJOK Architects; (PL)101 Rev.P03; Product specifications of multi split air conditioners from Daikin; (96)300 Rev.P01; TM59 THERMAL ANALYSIS REPORT ref. QTE024949 Rev.3 dated 05/11/2026 prepared by Enevo.

Reason: For the avoidance of doubt and in the interest of proper planning.
Condition : 3 - All new external work shall be carried out in materials that resemble, as closely as possible, in colour and texture those of the existing building, unless otherwise specified in the approved application. 

Reason: To safeguard the appearance of the premises and the character of the immediate area in accordance with the requirements of policies D1 and D2 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017 and policies DH2, DH5 and DH9 of the Highgate Neighbourhood Plan 2017.
Condition : 4 - The external noise levels emitted from plant/ machinery/ equipment shall ensure that the rating level of the noise emitted from the proposed installation located at the site shall not exceed the existing background level at any noise sensitive premises when measured and corrected in accordance with BS4142:2014 +A1:2019 "Methods for rating and assessing industrial and commercial sound.".

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site/ surrounding premises is not adversely affected by noise from mechanical installations/ equipment in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 5 - Prior to use, machinery, plant or equipment at the development shall be mounted with proprietary anti-vibration isolators and fan motors shall be vibration isolated from the casing and adequately silenced and maintained as such. 

Reason: To ensure that the amenity of occupiers of the development site and surrounding premises is not adversely affected by vibration in accordance with the requirements of policies A1 and A4 of the London Borough of Camden Local Plan 2017.
Condition : 6 - Prior to the commencement of works on site, tree protection measures shall be installed and working practices adopted in accordance with the document entitled "Tree Protection Plan" dated 01/10/2026 by Graftin Gardeners ref. 24-25890-TPP-001.  All trees on the site, or parts of trees grow from adjoining sites, unless shown on the permitted drawings as being removed, shall be retained and protected from damage in accordance with BS5837:2012 and with the approved protection details. The development shall be monitored by the project arboriculturalist in accordance with the approved report.

Reason: To ensure that the development will not have an adverse effect on existing trees and in order to maintain the character and amenity of the area in accordance with the requirements of policies A2 and A3 of the Camden Local Plan 2017 and policy OS2 of the Highgate Neighbourhood Plan 2017.
description: Erection of two rear dormers replacing the existing rear dormer, removal of the existing triangular front dormer, replacement of existing handrails with metal railings, installation of an A/C unit on rooftop, replacement of the glazed roof of the lower ground floor rear extension with a solid flat roof, lowering of ground floor rear terrace, and re-landscaping to front courtyard.
